meta.name: Zheng 2024 Natech: decision model, O1 (two-way updates)
meta.description: FRAM of Zheng et al. 2024 (CC BY 4.0, PSEP 188:514) converted under v2, with firefighters as a flow. Reference point: 40 % of the brigade drawn away, mutual aid at 30 min, telecom at level 3.

fn_0.label: Confirm location of fire
rules: worst_of(worst_of(alarm_information_2, well_performed_monitoring_system_2) + 1, best_of(alarm_information_2, well_performed_monitoring_system_2)) propagates to fn_0

fn_1.label: Contact the control room and shift officer for immediate action guidelines
rules: worst_of(worst_of(fire_information, radio_telephone_2, rescue_rules_and_regulations_2, all_relative_officers_stand_by_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(fire_information, radio_telephone_2), best_of(fire_information, rescue_rules_and_regulations_2), best_of(fire_information, all_relative_officers_stand_by_2), best_of(radio_telephone_2, rescue_rules_and_regulations_2), best_of(radio_telephone_2, all_relative_officers_stand_by_2), best_of(rescue_rules_and_regulations_2, all_relative_officers_stand_by_2))) propagates to fn_1

fn_2.label: Actuate siren
rules: worst_of(worst_of(immediate_action_guidelines, alarm_system_2, well_performed_warning_systems_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(immediate_action_guidelines, alarm_system_2), best_of(immediate_action_guidelines, well_performed_warning_systems_2), best_of(alarm_system_2, well_performed_warning_systems_2))) propagates to fn_2

fn_3.label: Contact fire department
rules: worst_of(worst_of(immediate_action_guidelines, radio_telephone_2, fire_department_standing_by_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(immediate_action_guidelines, radio_telephone_2), best_of(immediate_action_guidelines, fire_department_standing_by_2), best_of(radio_telephone_2, fire_department_standing_by_2))) propagates to fn_3

fn_4.label: Contact the fire marshal for instructions and actions
rules: worst_of(worst_of(successful_connection_with_fire_departme, radio_telephone_2, fire_marshal_standing_by_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(successful_connection_with_fire_departme, radio_telephone_2), best_of(successful_connection_with_fire_departme, fire_marshal_standing_by_2), best_of(radio_telephone_2, fire_marshal_standing_by_2))) propagates to fn_4

fn_5.label: Establish if any missing persons at assembly muster and advise fire officer
rules: worst_of(worst_of(immediate_action_guidelines, internet_telephone_2, publication_of_information) + 1, worst_of(best_of(immediate_action_guidelines, internet_telephone_2), best_of(immediate_action_guidelines, publication_of_information), best_of(internet_telephone_2, publication_of_information))) propagates to fn_5

fn_6.label: Establish incident command post and advise fire team leaders
rules: worst_of(worst_of(specific_action_description, internet_telephone_2, all_related_departments_standing_by_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(specific_action_description, internet_telephone_2), best_of(specific_action_description, all_related_departments_standing_by_2), best_of(internet_telephone_2, all_related_departments_standing_by_2))) propagates to fn_6

fn_7.label: Post the accident location and information
rules: worst_of(worst_of(successful_connection_with_fire_departme, internet_telephone_2, principles_of_releasing_accident_informa_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(successful_connection_with_fire_departme, internet_telephone_2), best_of(successful_connection_with_fire_departme, principles_of_releasing_accident_informa_2), best_of(internet_telephone_2, principles_of_releasing_accident_informa_2))) propagates to fn_7

fn_8.label: Check extent of fire and escalation potential
rules: worst_of(worst_of(incident_command_post, experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2, internet_telephone_2, information_on_fire_fuel_and_facilities_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(incident_command_post, experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2), best_of(incident_command_post, internet_telephone_2), best_of(incident_command_post, information_on_fire_fuel_and_facilities_2), best_of(experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2, internet_telephone_2), best_of(experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2, information_on_fire_fuel_and_facilities_2), best_of(internet_telephone_2, information_on_fire_fuel_and_facilities_2))) propagates to fn_8

fn_9.label: Evaluate the availability of equipment and resources
rules: worst_of(worst_of(incident_command_post, experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2, internet_telephone_2, information_on_equipment_and_resources_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(incident_command_post, experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2), best_of(incident_command_post, internet_telephone_2), best_of(incident_command_post, information_on_equipment_and_resources_2), best_of(experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2, internet_telephone_2), best_of(experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2, information_on_equipment_and_resources_2), best_of(internet_telephone_2, information_on_equipment_and_resources_2))) propagates to fn_9

fn_10.label: Assess flame or heat affected facilities

fn_11.label: Develop response guidelines
rules: worst_of(worst_of(confirming_a_person_s_status, the_fire_risk_evaluation_results_and_pre, the_evaluation_results_on_available_equi, the_evaluation_results_of_facilities, experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2, rescue_rules_and_regulations_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(confirming_a_person_s_status, the_fire_risk_evaluation_results_and_pre), best_of(confirming_a_person_s_status, the_evaluation_results_on_available_equi), best_of(confirming_a_person_s_status, the_evaluation_results_of_facilities), best_of(confirming_a_person_s_status, experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2), best_of(confirming_a_person_s_status, rescue_rules_and_regulations_2), best_of(the_fire_risk_evaluation_results_and_pre, the_evaluation_results_on_available_equi), best_of(the_fire_risk_evaluation_results_and_pre, the_evaluation_results_of_facilities), best_of(the_fire_risk_evaluation_results_and_pre, experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2), best_of(the_fire_risk_evaluation_results_and_pre, rescue_rules_and_regulations_2), best_of(the_evaluation_results_on_available_equi, the_evaluation_results_of_facilities), best_of(the_evaluation_results_on_available_equi, experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2), best_of(the_evaluation_results_on_available_equi, rescue_rules_and_regulations_2), best_of(the_evaluation_results_of_facilities, experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2), best_of(the_evaluation_results_of_facilities, rescue_rules_and_regulations_2), best_of(experts_with_process_experience_and_know_2, rescue_rules_and_regulations_2))) propagates to fn_11

fn_12.label: Send technician to stand-by with equipment and resource
rules: worst_of(worst_of(response_guidelines, sufficient_technician_2) + 1, best_of(response_guidelines, sufficient_technician_2)) propagates to fn_12

fn_13.label: Isolate equipment and commence shutdown of affected and related facilities
rules: worst_of(worst_of(technician_standing_by, information_on_equipment_and_facilities_2) + 1, best_of(technician_standing_by, information_on_equipment_and_facilities_2)) propagates to fn_13

fn_14.label: Pump the product of tanks 52, 53 and 54 to other tanks
rules: worst_of(worst_of(technician_standing_by, pump_facilities_2, standard_of_pump_operation_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(technician_standing_by, pump_facilities_2), best_of(technician_standing_by, standard_of_pump_operation_2), best_of(pump_facilities_2, standard_of_pump_operation_2))) propagates to fn_14

fn_15.label: Respond to the incident area for shutdown supervision
rules: worst_of(worst_of(successfully_isolating_and_shutting_down, successfully_transferring_the_product_to, technician_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(successfully_isolating_and_shutting_down, successfully_transferring_the_product_to), best_of(successfully_isolating_and_shutting_down, technician_2), best_of(successfully_transferring_the_product_to, technician_2))) propagates to fn_15

fn_16.label: Assemble the fire team with equipment and resource
rules: worst_of(crews, worst_of(response_guidelines, firetruck_firefighter_ppe_scbas_etc_2) + 1, best_of(response_guidelines, firetruck_firefighter_ppe_scbas_etc_2)) propagates to fn_16

fn_17.label: All members don firefighting PPE, and SCBAS for firefighters in the hot zone
rules: worst_of(worst_of(successfully_assembling_enough_scbas_ppe, response_guidelines, standard_of_wearing_firefighting_ppe_and_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(successfully_assembling_enough_scbas_ppe, response_guidelines), best_of(successfully_assembling_enough_scbas_ppe, standard_of_wearing_firefighting_ppe_and_2), best_of(response_guidelines, standard_of_wearing_firefighting_ppe_and_2))) propagates to fn_17

fn_18.label: Ensure all members don firefighting PPE
rules: worst_of(worst_of(firefighters_wearing_ppe_and_scbas, response_guidelines, standard_of_wearing_firefighting_ppe_scb_2) + 1, worst_of(best_of(firefighters_wearing_ppe_and_scbas, response_guidelines), best_of(firefighters_wearing_ppe_and_scbas, standard_of_wearing_firefighting_ppe_scb_2), best_of(response_guidelines, standard_of_wearing_firefighting_ppe_scb_2))) propagates to fn_18

fn_19.label: Direct fire team to inject foam to the bund wall under fire
